what_it_does: Quantum data centers house multiple quantum processors (QPUs) in different racks connected by optical switches that can be reconfigured to route quantum communications. SwitchQNet is a compiler that co-designs both the quantum algorithm (how qubits are routed and gates are decomposed) and the optical network schedule to minimize communication latency and switch reconfiguration overhead. By batching quantum operations and reordering them to amortize the cost of switching the optical paths, the system reduces total execution time and improves the fidelity (accuracy) of quantum computations, critical for fault-tolerant quantum computing.
